official_definition: By -3/-6 counters (send three/six cores from your Counter Area to the Void), when three cores are sent, return three cards from the opposing Trash to the opposing decktop; when six cores are sent, next turn doesn't occur for the opponent. This counter -6 can only be used once per game.

ownership_rules.native_syntax: Ability block header contains [Chrono-Count Break] or [Chrono-Count Break: Param]
ownership_rules.prose_exclusion: Mentions inside body clauses ("with [Chrono-Count Break]", "give [Chrono-Count Break]") classified as REFERENCES or GRANTED, never NATIVE.

resolution.description: Mutates game state as specified by official effect text.
